test_title: PYST 8: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

B sits to the immediate right of C. Only three people sit between B and A when counted from the left of B. Only three people sit between C and D when counted from the left of C. G sits to the immediate right of F. How many people sit between A and C when counted from the right of C?
solution: Persons: A, B, C, D, E, F, G All face centre **Circular arrangement (facing centre → left = clockwise, right = anticlockwise)** B sits immediate right of C [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bee7117fa344d3e8d6d2ff340a60051bf630b552c12da9df16bb8b34c58e3dad.png] 3 persons between B and A from left of B
